page.layout: One page of text. Two coin woodcuts (medallions with portraits and legends) at the top, not text. Below them, one full-width column of running text. A decorative ornament at the foot, not text. No marginal notes.

main_text.l: ROBOAM filius Salomonis ex Naama Pharaonis filia,
mortuo patre regnavit super filios Israël qui habitabant in ci-
vitatibus Juda, anno mundi 2971.ante Christum natum 991.
nam decem tribus ad Jeroboam defecerant.Hic Roboam spre-
to senum consilio, juvenum consilium amplexatus est, super-
bissimè respondens populo qui tributorum imminutionem po-
stulabat:quamobrem defciuerunt ab eo decem tribus. ipse au-
tem 80000. virorum congregavit ex tribu Juda & Ben-jamin,
ut sub jugum ejus qui filius & hæres Salomonis erat,mitterent
has decem tribus quæ ad Jeroboam defecerant: sed ut ne pu-
gnaret prohibuit Dominus, dicens à se factū esse istud, quem-
admodum per Ahiam Prophetam prædixerat. Vide 3. Reg. 11.
8.cap.7. & 8.regnavit annos 17, cui successit filius, nomine A-
SESACH rex Ægypti, ascendit in Jerusalem, & tulit the-
sauros domus Domini,& thesauros regios & universa diripuit,
anno quinto regni Roboam. habebat Sesac in exercitu 1200.

page.notes: Coin legends are engraved in the medallions and are not running text. Left medallion: "ROBOM" along the left edge and "R. IVDA" along the right edge. Right medallion: "SESACH R." along the left edge and "AE" at the upper right [?]. Some words in the first paragraph are hard to read at this scan resolution, notably "Josephlib." and the digits "2971" and "80000"; the spacing around the numbers may differ from the print. "defecerant.Hic" lacks a printed space, which is kept as printed. The Latin spelling was changed only for u/v and i/j as the rules require; "Ægypti", "defciuerunt", "factū" and "Abiam" are unchanged.
